name: Can you please make my multi

messages.content: Can you please make my multi page website from my mock up

I'd be happy to build your multi-page website! However, it looks like the mockup wasn't attached or uploaded to the project yet. 

Could you please share or attach your mockup (images, PDF, Figma export, or a description of the pages and layout)? Once you share it, I'll get started right away!

I attached an image: .antigravity/uploads/photo-1794184122-1.jpg.

How? I’m uploading the picture it’s not doing anything

I have built your complete **MILEYM3DIA** multi-page website matching all 14 panels from your mockup!

You can view your live website here:
👉 **[View Your Live Site](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/bbe12442-f480-4394-8120-984b788bc225/bb044950e501b3504343fdad/)**

---

### What Was Built:

| # | Page | File | Key Features & Implementation |
|---|------|------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **Home Page** | [`index.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html) | Hero with neon yellow doodle crown & *"IDEAS INTO REALITY"* badge, animated marquee ticker, 4 featured work showcase cards, creative solutions grid, and bottom CTA banner. |
| 2 | **About Page** | [`about.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/about.html) | *"The Vision Behind The Creative"* hero, philosophy section, stats counter row (`10+`, `100+`, `100%`), and the 4 Core Pillars (*Creativity*, *Authenticity*, *Community*, *Growth*). |
| 3 | **Services Page** | [`services.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/services.html) | Full services breakdown covering Branding, Web Dev, Video & Editing, Social Media, Audio Production, Digital Tools, Creative Direction, and Consulting. |
| 4 | **Portfolio Page** | [`portfolio.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/portfolio.html) | Interactive category filter buttons (*All, Branding, Web, Video, Social, Audio, Tools*), interactive case study modal overlays, and instant Creative Brief download. |
| 5 | **Blog Page** | [`blog.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/blog.html) | Real-time live search filter, interactive category filtering, recent posts sidebar, and articles list linking to full story posts. |
| 6 | **Resources Page** | [`resources.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/resources.html) | Filterable downloads vault (*Templates, Guides, Tools, Inspiration, Free*), instant downloadable files (LUTs, checklists, guides), and newsletter subscription. |
| 7 | **Creators Hub Page** | [`hub.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/hub.html) | Hub feature pillars (*Exclusive Resources, Community, Workshops, Benefits*), Latest Updates feed, and member join links. |
| 8 | **Contact Page** | [`contact.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/contact.html) | Interactive project inquiry form with budget/timeline selectors, live confirmation modal, studio direct contact info, and PA location details. |
| 9 | **Single Blog Post** | [`blog-post.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/blog-post.html) | *"The Power of Visual Storytelling"* full article, cinematic studio visual, blockquotes, author bio for Andrew Miley, and social share triggers. |
| 10 | **404 Page** | [`404.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/404.html) | Glowing neon `404 NOT FOUND` with graffiti crown doodle, interactive search bar, suggested article cards, and return button. |
| 11 | **Login / Register** | [`login.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/login.html) | Split login & registration container, remember-me options, modal register dialog, and 1-click instant demo access into the inner lab. |
| 12 | **Creator Lab (Inner Portal)** | [`creator-lab.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/creator-lab.html) | Member portal for **Andrew Miley** with active sidebar navigation (*Dashboard, Resources Vault, Workshops, Community Feed, Studio Tools, Settings*). |
| 13 | **MileyInk (Tattoo Studio)** | [`mileyink.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/mileyink.html) | Sub-brand page for *"Custom Tattoos. Bold Ideas."* with gallery preview, artist backstory, aftercare protocols, and private consultation booking modal. |
| 14 | **AMM Sounz (Audio Production)** | [`amm-sounz.html`](file:///home/agent/workspace/amm-sounz.html) | Audio brand with an **interactive Web Audio beat player** (plays synthesized beats live in the browser), stem mixing booking, and sample packs. |

---

### Key Technical Details:
- **Design System** ([`style.css`](file:///home/agent/workspace/css/style.css)): Dark cyberpunk aesthetic (`#08080b`), neon chartreuse/lime (`#d4ff00`), electric cyan (`#00f0ff`), and magenta accents, custom SVG doodle crowns, and typography using *Syne* and *Space Grotesk*.
- **Interactive Scripts**:
  - [`main.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/main.js): Mobile navigation drawer, universal toast notification system, and modal handling.
  - [`portfolio.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/portfolio.js): Category filtering and dynamic modal case studies.
  - [`blog.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/blog.js): Instant live search across all articles.
  - [`resources.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/resources.js): Category filters and instant downloads.
  - [`sound-player.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/sound-player.js): Web Audio synthesis engine for AMM Sounz track playback.
All assets, interactive scripts, and 14 mock-up pages are completely loaded, synced, and active. 

You can explore your live site at any time here:
👉 **[Open Your Website](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/bbe12442-f480-4394-8120-984b788bc225/bb044950e501b3504343fdad/)**

Feel free to click through the pages, test the interactive beat player on AMM Sounz, try out the search and filters on the blog and portfolio, or let me know if you'd like to adjust any text, colors, or features!
